Quick Answers

Frequently Asked Questions

Check-in is from 2:00pm onwards. Check-out is until 12:00nn (noon). Early check-in and late check-out may be available on request, subject to room availability — just let us know in advance.
Yes, walk-in guests are welcome. We recommend contacting us in advance — especially on weekends and holidays — to make sure we have availability waiting for you.
Several activities are complimentary for all guests — beach volleyball, inflatable pool, darts, board games, and card games. Paid activities (ATV ₱1,600/hour · banana boat ₱200/ride · dragon boat ₱200/ride) are charged separately.
Yes — free on-site parking is available for all guests.
Absolutely. We love hosting reunions, team outings, birthdays, and special occasions. Send us a message above or call us directly and we’ll put something together for your group.
We have Wi-Fi available at the resort, though connectivity in coastal areas can vary. We gently encourage you to put the phone down — the view is better without a screen in front of it.
Please get in touch with us directly for cancellation and rescheduling arrangements. We handle each situation with flexibility and care — we understand that plans sometimes change.
